release.notes: Adds the optional private Student Portal: bulk-publish selected-term activity records with masked names and individual access codes, pause student viewing, unpublish selected or all records, and reset access codes. Includes a fictional demo; no classroom records upload automatically. Brings consistent blue/teal styling and readable controls across the teacher workspace and game popups, plus schedule maintenance and expanded trial-expiry regression checks. Includes all prior classroom features and preserves records, settings and activation. Portal publishing requires a separately provisioned connection; publishing credentials are never bundled in the installer.
